comments.author: GlassFullOfSlop
comments.body_html:
Hmm, I’m not uninterested in doing more. However the only reason I did this one is because it was a request from a friend and I thought I might as well share since the last one hasn’t been updated in a year.

However Yunthegane already has Reflex Collection so the work has already been done, maybe contact him to see if he is willing to update?

As people have noted in the comments there, bundles don’t really stop working as far as I know, the only thing that stops working is the mod wrapper with SPT updates, so you can manually replace those files if you really wanted. All the bundle mods do is make a user friendly way to load those files without replacing vanilla ones.
